explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/619, which records EGR98's h_3(G) ≤ n. Implicit in that is that every connected triangle-free graph extends by added edges to a triangle-free graph of diameter ≤ 3. The statement asserts exactly this existence: H ≥ G, CliqueFree 3, ediam ≤ 3. It is a faithful supporting result.
